questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: A trader buys a bag of rice for ₦40,000 and sells it for ₦46,000. What is the profit percent?
questions.explain: Profit = ₦6,000. Profit percent = (6,000 ÷ 40,000) × 100 = 15%. Always divide by the cost price.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: What is 20% of ₦3,500?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Find the simple interest on ₦50,000 at 8% per year for 3 years.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: Solve 3x + 5 = 20.
questions.explain: Subtract 5: 3x = 15. Divide by 3: x = 5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: An okada charges ₦200 plus ₦100 per km. A trip costs ₦900. How many km?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: What are the roots of x² − 5x + 6 = 0?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: If the discriminant b² − 4ac is negative, the quadratic has…
questions.explain: A negative discriminant means no real roots.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: What is the median of 4, 6, 8, 10?
questions.explain: Even number of values: average the two middle ones, (6 + 8) ÷ 2 = 7.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.q: A plot is 30 m long and 20 m wide. What is its area?
questions.explain: Area = length × width = 30 × 20 = 600 m².

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: A car goes from 0 to 20 m/s in 5 s. What is its acceleration?

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: Which of these is a vector quantity?
questions.explain: Velocity has both size and direction, so it is a vector.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: A force of 10 N acts on a 2 kg mass. What is the acceleration?
questions.explain: F = ma, so a = F ÷ m = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 m/s².

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: Passengers jerk forward when a bus stops suddenly. This is explained by…
questions.explain: Their bodies tend to keep moving: inertia, Newton's first law.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: The SI unit of power is the…
questions.explain: Power = work ÷ time, measured in watts (W).

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: A 5 V charger is connected to a 2.5 Ω circuit. What current flows?

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: Why are houses wired in parallel?
options: One bulb going off does not switch off the others
questions.explain: In parallel, each appliance has its own path for current.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: A metal spoon in hot soup becomes hot by…
questions.explain: Heat passes through solids by conduction.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.q: Convert 27 °C to kelvin.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Sodium has atomic number 11 and mass number 23. How many neutrons does it have?
questions.explain: Neutrons = mass number − atomic number = 23 − 11 = 12.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Atoms of the same element with different numbers of neutrons are called…
questions.explain: Isotopes have the same protons but different neutrons.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Sodium chloride is held together by…
questions.explain: Sodium gives an electron to chlorine, forming Na⁺ and Cl⁻ ions: an ionic bond.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: A solution with pH 3 is…
questions.explain: pH below 7 is acidic.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Acid + base → ?
questions.explain: Neutralisation gives salt and water.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which method separates chaff from millet grains using wind?
questions.explain: Winnowing uses moving air to blow away the light chaff.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Palm oil and water can be separated with a…
questions.explain: They are immiscible liquids, so a separating funnel is used.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which change will NOT speed up a reaction?
options: Using larger lumps instead of powder
questions.explain: Larger lumps have less surface area, so the reaction is slower.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Which gas is released during photosynthesis?
questions.explain: Photosynthesis releases oxygen as a by-product.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: The green pigment that traps light energy is…
questions.explain: Chlorophyll in the chloroplasts traps light energy.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Carbon dioxide enters the leaf through the…
questions.explain: Stomata are small pores on the leaf surface.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Which structure is found in plant cells but NOT in animal cells?
questions.explain: Plant cells have a cellulose cell wall; animal cells do not.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Anaerobic respiration in yeast produces…
questions.explain: Yeast ferments sugar into alcohol and carbon dioxide (palm wine, bread).

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Respiration takes place in the…
questions.explain: Mitochondria release energy from glucose.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Malaria is caused by…
questions.explain: The Plasmodium parasite causes malaria; the mosquito only carries it.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: The vector of malaria is the female…
questions.explain: The female Anopheles mosquito spreads malaria.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: In grass → grasshopper → lizard → hawk, the producer is the…
questions.explain: Food chains start with a green plant, the producer.
